The branch stays as defence in depth.

SpotDriver._opened and SpotDriver._robot are assigned together under one lock in open() and cleared together in close(), so `_robot is None` holds exactly when `not _opened` does: the second term of the guard is redundant and no caller can tell the two guards apart.
